desc: The Lug-Lok Upper Vise block uses the strength of barrel lugs to safely secure AR15 upper receivers while you work, rendering clamp-style blocks obsolete. The non-marring, aircraft-grade aluminum block slides through the upper receiver and into the star chamber of your barrel. This takes the pressure from torquing away from weak, damage prone parts and puts it squarely on the steel lugs. Adjustable Vise Pins hold the block at the optimal working angle and the Lock Knob ensures the upper receiver stays exactly where you want it.
